primary_meaning: the Holy Spirit (who imparts eternal life and quenches spiritual thirst)
primary_basis: John 4:10-14 (Jesus as giver of living water welling up to eternal life)
Jeremiah 2:13 and 17:13 (Yahweh as fountain of living waters, read christologically)
Revelation 7:17; 21:6; 22:1, 17 (river/water of life from God and the Lamb)

alternatives.meaning: eternal life or salvation offered by Christ
the word or teaching of God/Christ
basis: occasional patristic and later homiletic applications linking living water to Scripture or gospel proclamation
early church liturgical and catechetical use connecting John 4/7 to baptism

alternatives.meaning: Christ himself as the source of life
basis: Johannine Christology and some medieval spiritual readings

notes: Johannine texts supply the dominant Christian symbolic reading; Old Testament fountain imagery is consistently re-read through the lens of John 7. Alternative emphases (salvation, word, baptism) are not contradictory but secondary or contextual expansions of the same complex.
